verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS data platform that ships an SDK, a hybrid agent and an MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to opt out. Data blocking and column hashing control which synced source data is moved, not product telemetry, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
